item.title: StepFun Step 5 Preview: ~600B MoE Long-Horizon Agent; Open Weights Due Oct 15
item.description: StepFun launched Step 5 Preview on September 20, 2026: a ~600B sparse MoE (~27B active) with 1M context for long-horizon agents, API live now and BF16 open weights planned for October 15.

item.title: Tencent Marvis Becomes AI Butler Team: PC, File, Browser and Software Agents
item.description: Tencent upgraded Marvis from AI assistant to AI butler around four agents—PC, file, browser and software—citing about 92% PC-task completion and planned user-built butler skills.

item.title: NaiveAI Open-Weights Naive-N0.5-Flash: 309B MoE, Hybrid SWA–DSA 1M Context, MIT
item.description: NaiveAI released Naive-N0.5-Flash as MIT open weights: a 309B MoE with 15.5B active, hybrid SWA–DSA native 1M context for coding and AI R&D, built on MiMo-V2.5 without full-attention layers.

item.title: MiniMax Puts M3.1-Flash-Preview Coding Model Live Inside MiniMax Code
item.description: On September 27, 2026 MiniMax confirmed M3.1-Flash-Preview inside MiniMax Code for everyday coding work, with a five-level reasoning resource slider and no full public model card this round.

item.title: Meituan Ships LongCat-2.5-Preview: 1.6T MoE Multimodal Agent Model With 1M Context
item.description: Meituan launched LongCat-2.5-Preview on September 25, 2026: a 1.6T MoE (~48B active) with native 1M-token multimodal context aimed at long-horizon software agents, without publishing benchmarks this round.
